notes: Official API model ID speech-2.8-hd (T2A HTTP, WebSocket and async long-form endpoints). Released 2026-01-23 with Speech 2.8. Higher-quality voice with sound tags, 40 languages and 7 emotions. USD 100 per 1 million input characters. Older speech-2.6 and speech-02 models are listed by MiniMax as legacy at the same prices and are not included. Null V1 token fields mean not applicable, not free.

price_records.billing_note: MiniMax international pay-as-you-go price, billed by input text characters; do not convert to tokens or minutes. The sync T2A endpoint and the async long-form endpoint (up to 1M characters per request) cost the same. Voice Design ($3 per voice) and Rapid Voice Cloning ($1.5 per voice) are charged once, when the voice is first used. Audio Packages (monthly audio points) are a separate billing option and are not listed here. Prices on the Chinese mainland platform (minimaxi.com) are in CNY and differ.
